summary.text: Steven Foster is a Republican member of the Maine House of Representatives for House District 32, Penobscot County, representing Bradford, Charleston, Dexter, Exeter, Garland, and Stetson.
The page lists Steven Foster as ranking member of the Energy, Utilities and Technology committee.

paragraphs.text: The House page lists Steven Foster's education as MMA, KVCC (B.S. Marine Engineering, Associate Pulp and Paper Technology, 1978, 2002).
The page lists Steven Foster's occupation as Retired Engineer.
Listed affiliations include MSAD 46/ AOS 94 School Board 2000-2012, Hunting, Fishing.
Steven Foster lives in Dexter and has served 4 sessions in the House, most recently the 132nd Legislature.
Committee assignments listed: Energy, Utilities and Technology (ranking member).
Family details on the page: married, spouse Sharon, 3 children, 6 grandchildren.
